policy: Runtime models must be MIT or Apache-2.0 with full provenance (room addendum r1.0). Models are never committed: download by the recorded URL and revision, then verify sha256 before use.

hash_evidence_levels.MEASURED: sha256 computed locally on the downloaded file and equal to the published value
hash_evidence_levels.PUBLISHED: sha256 published by the host (Hugging Face LFS pointer or GitHub release asset digest), file not downloaded here

models.role: topic labels and candidate evidence quotes (proposals only, validated by code)
models.license_evidence: Hugging Face repo tag license:apache-2.0 and LICENSE file in the repo

models.role: upstream of the GGUF above (provenance only)
same role as qwen3-0.6b-q8_0; tested only to see if a larger model fixes Swahili labels

models.notes: Only Q8_0 is published in this repo (1.83 GB). A smaller Q4 quant for the phone would come from another source and need its own provenance entry.
